extraction_notes: SI Table S1 is a literature-comparison table and was excluded. Characterisation sections and figures were excluded. Support-only rows with no products reported (TiO2 at 175 °C and ZnTiO3 at 175 °C in SI Table S3) were excluded under the no-products rule. CO and CH4 productivities are printed in the SI tables but the target schema has no separate fields for them; only methanol productivity/STY was entered.
